metadata.description: Setup skills for Treasure AI Studio: AI Signals models and custom AI agents, set up step by step in a Work Folder — templates are copied into the folder and customized, outputs stay in agent_outputs/, and each project gets its own agent skill.

plugins.name: ai-signals-skills
plugins.description: Set up AI Signals models on your Treasure Data account and get a project agent and dashboard for each: RFM customer segmentation, Next Best Product recommendations, Multi-Touch Attribution, Next Best Action engagement scores, and propensity scoring (binary classification for churn, lead scoring, conversion or response).

plugins.name: custom-agent-skills
plugins.description: Set up custom AI agents on your Treasure Data data: an audience and segment-analysis agent for any CDP parent segment, and a custom HTML dashboard (new, or converted from a .dash export, HTML file or screenshot) with its own dashboard agent.
